svg.aria-label: Graphs of y = 2 to the x and y = log base 2 of x, mirror images across the dashed line y = x
svg.title: An exponential function and its inverse
svg.desc: y = 2^x and y = log₂ x reflect across the dashed line y = x. The point (2, 4) on the exponential matches (4, 2) on the logarithm, and (0, 1) matches (1, 0). The exponential has the horizontal asymptote y = 0; the logarithm has the vertical asymptote x = 0.
